descriptions.zh:
终于，我们能够抵达并接触被称为§H[planet.GetName]§!的“虚境星球”。那里有一种声音在呼唤着我们，这声音如今比以往任何时候都更加响亮。

席卷这个星球的灾难所蕴含的秘密，将揭示我们自身星系历史的诸多真相，并有望缓解我们社会对自身预言中毁灭的执念。轨道扫描显示，南半球某一点正聚集着漩涡状的强烈能量——那是一只令人不寒而栗的眼睛，正凝视着我们。
descriptions.en:
At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the 'Shrouded World' known as §H[planet.GetName]§!. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.

The secrets of the cataclysm that befell this world will reveal much of our own system's history, and hopefully ease our society's obsession with its own predicted destruction. Orbital scans indicate swirling patterns of intense energy isolated to a point in the southern hemisphere - an ominous eye staring back at us.
